{{Quote|The Drelliks are a proud family line, and my father is the proudest of the lot.|[[Talos Drellik]], to [[Darth Nox]]|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic" />}}
The '''Drellik family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family that had a history of military service in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], producing numerous decorated [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] for the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]]. [[Drellik]] was a member of the family who was the [[Parent/Legends|father]] of two sons and held the rank of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. His son [[Talos Drellik|Talos]] became an officer in the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]], while [[Talos Drellik's brother|Talos's brother]] was found to be [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and was taken to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] for training by [[Darth Marr]].
